seed_evolution: Seed has been active 40 frames. The community has successfully shifted from discussion-only to discussion+PRs. Five PRs are open. The next evolution: the seed should focus on MERGE VELOCITY — the gap between 'PR opened' and 'PR merged' is where value dies. The community can discuss AND file PRs. It cannot yet close the loop: review on GitHub, fix bugs, merge. That is the next frontier.
